title: The Expert Myth
summary: Veritasium examines which experts have real expertise, drawing on chess research and work by Klein and Kahneman. It explains that expertise comes from pattern recognition built through deliberate practice in valid, feedback-rich environments.
why: Frequently recommended in threads on learning, the 10,000 hours rule and deliberate practice as a clearer account of how expertise develops.

quote.text: Veritasium has a really good video on the subject [0], with a much more compelling explanation for what it takes to develop expertise.
